protocol.source: Stored NASA GMAT trajectories and the shared hpop-reference-cases.json protocol; all historical scores retained.
protocol.units: maximum 3D position difference, metres; STM relative column difference, dimensionless
protocol.frame: GCRF; EME2000 for explicitly marked EME2000 cases
protocol.toleranceRationale: Unchanged shared GMAT protocol: point mass 0.01 m, gravity 0.05 m, SRP 0.1 m, drag 1.5 m. Corrected drag also compared with the shared default 0.1 m. The JR atmosphere frame note is retained verbatim.
protocol.replayToleranceRationale: Exact replay of the same shipped WASM, inputs and settings. C++ disables fused multiply-add so kilometre-to-metre conversion rounds before subtraction as in the historical scorer; the C++ norm reproduces both stored scores exactly. worstM, atHour and integration steps must all match exactly.

verdict.statement: 55 of 55 R2022a cases meet the stated GMAT limits at the suite setting. These drag cases use Jacchia-Roberts, not NRLMSISE-00; the R2026a anomalous-oxygen diagnosis is not applicable. The existing JR drag note and 17 skipped cases are retained.

stm.statement: R2022a has no stored STM comparisons; no agreement claim is made.
